policy.configuration_selection: all applicable detectors and fixed similarity threshold; only the per-market sample-floor rung is selected after holdout to pursue the declared coverage target
policy.warmup: detector-specific requirements; no shared 120-bar startup gate
policy.risk_distance: full pattern height or declared specialist rule; unchanged
policy.overlap: all distinct detections; simultaneous observations per pattern/method/direction allowed
policy.statistical_assumption: Wilson/binomial values are nominal; within-sample overlap correlations are not adjusted
policy.multiple_testing: BY-adjusted nominal p-values reported; not proof of significance for dependent observations
policy.coverage_target: at least 2 qualified configurations per coin and timeframe when the fixed evidence floor permits; not forced if accuracy fails
policy.coverage_floor_note: The default floor is 15m=100, 1h=75, 4h=50, 1D=30. A predeclared ladder may lower it only to the allowed floors 15m=50, 1h=30, 4h=20, 1D=15 to fill the coverage target; low-N results are visibly cautioned in the UI
